claim: YMIN, the top of the vertical strip, is DECIMAL 42: YMIN EQU 42 — the floor the player Y clamps at (YMIN+1) and objects wrap on.
YMAX, the bottom of the vertical strip, is DECIMAL 240: YMAX EQU 240 — the ceiling objects wrap on.
BGL is the camera — the 16-bit world-X of the screen's left edge: BGL RMB 2, 'TERRAIN LEFT POINTER'. The world is a horizontal cylinder BGL wraps around.
BGLX is last frame's camera — 'OLD TERRAIN LEFT': BGLX RMB 2. The per-frame scroll delta objects and stars ride is BGL minus BGLX.
The ship's target screen column is $20-based facing right: LDA #$20 '+BASE', the left-third lead column so the ship leads the scroll rightward.
The ship's target screen column is $70-based facing left: PV1 LDA #$70 '-BASE', the right-side lead column so the ship leads the scroll leftward.
The camera-slide in-range window half-width is $100: CMPD #$100 'IN RANGE?' — a target-vs-onscreen diff within it means no slide (the + boundary is inclusive via the following BLS).
The camera-slide step (BGDELT) is $40 per frame when the ship is out of the in-range window: LDD #$40 (stored into BGDELT on the next line).
